papers.title: Context-structured Video Anomaly Detection with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Dongjun Kim, Changjae Oh, Andrea Cavallaro, Jeonghoon Mo
papers.tags: object detection, tracking, multimodal learning, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: Yonsei University; Queen Mary University of London; EPFL
papers.intro: 本文提出CSI-VAD，一个免训练的视频异常检测框架，通过将视频分解为环境、物体和时间三种不同上下文并分别进行推理，再利用聚合策略得到视频级判断，从而克服整体推理对上下文特定异常线索的遗漏问题。

papers.title: Mitigating Modality and Language-Style Gaps for Zero-Shot Video Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: Jihyun Lee, Cheol-Ho Cho, Woojin Jun, Woojin Jeong, Jae-Pil Heo
papers.affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University, Suwon, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出Self-SiMS（Self-Similarity-based Moment proposal and Scoring），通过利用视频内部的自我相似性来生成和评分候选时间段，并辅以查询感知的MLLM重排序，从而在不依赖训练的情况下缓解模态差距和语言风格差距，实现零样本视频时刻检索的SOTA性…

papers.title: Dual-Edged Homogeneous-Modality Similarity: Towards Visible-Infrared Modality-Incomplete Person Re-Identification with Modality Adaptive Matching
papers.authors: Xin Xu, Shuhao Zhan, Wei Liu, Zheng Wang, Kui Jiang, Chia-Wen Lin
papers.affiliations: Wuhan University of Science and Technology; Wuhan University; Harbin Institute of Technology; National Tsing Hua University（详见第十二节作者机构明细）
papers.intro: 本论文形式化了开放世界中可见-红外模态不完整行人重识别（VIMI-ReID）任务，构建了SYSU-VIMI与RegDB-VIMI两个基准，并提出Modality Adaptive Matching Transformer（MAMT）框架，通过共享Transformer模块与发散Transformer…

papers.title: The Many Senses of Visual Similarity: A Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Metric
papers.authors: Sheng-Yu Wang, Yotam Nitzan, Aaron Hertzmann, Jun-Yan Zhu, Eli Shechtman, Alexei A. Efros, Richard Zhang
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Adobe Research, UC Berkeley
papers.intro: 本文通过收集大规模、多方面的文本条件化相似性判断数据集，微调视觉语言模型得到TPIPS（Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Similarity），实现对不同视觉方面（如颜色、形状、纹理等）的文本提示条件化相似性度量，并在多个任务中验证其优于现有方法。

papers.title: Simple Domain Generalization for Strong Pixel-Level Image Tampering Detection in Modern VLMs
papers.authors: Yi Tang, Xinyi Shang, Jiacheng Cui, Sondos Mahmoud Bsharat, Jiacheng Liu, Xiaohan Zhao, Tran Dinh Tien, Ahmed Elhagry, Salwa K. Al Khatib, Tianjun Yao, Yonina C. Eldar, Jing-Hao Xue, Hao Li, Salman Khan, Zhiqiang Shen
papers.affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, University College London, Weizmann Institute of Science
papers.intro: 本文提出一个简单但有效的域泛化训练框架PIXAR-DG，通过平衡小批量采样、后期注入策略和低学习率调度，显著提升了像素级图像篡改检测在跨VLM分布下的OOD鲁棒性。

papers.title: Three-Body Scattering for Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Peng Sun, Zhenglin Cheng, Deyuan Liu, Jun Xie, Xinyi Shang, Tao Lin
papers.affiliations: 未明确（正文第一页标注作者所属机构，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 提出三体散射建模（TBSM），将能量距离转化为每个投射体的常大小随机交互，通过回归冻结的瞬时散射目标或在线跟踪的条件期望，实现高维一步生成器的高效训练，在ImageNet-256上以单步采样达到FID=1.63。

papers.title: Robust Multimodal Dynamic Object Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhe Xin, Hanzhi Chang, Penghui Huang, Yinian Mao, Guoquan Huang
papers.affiliations: Meituan UAV, Beijing, China；University of Delaware, Newark, DE, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出一种融合2D点跟踪、3D重建和语义信息的多模态动态物体分割框架，通过Transformer与特征聚类聚合网络对多模态轨迹进行分类，并结合基于点查询的SAM后处理，在动态分割和静态场景重建上达到SOTA性能。

papers.title: Plenoptic Condensation: A Novel Approach to Generalized Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Brevin Tilmon, Alex DeJournett, John Leffingwell, Scott Ackerson
papers.affiliations: Quidient, Columbia, MD
papers.intro: 本文提出Plenoptic Condensation (PCon)，一种多阶段自适应冷凝流水线，从低表示能力的“汤状”元素出发，联合重建物质场和光场，生成高保真、可重新照明的统一场景模型（Reality Model），在几何精度、外观逼真度和PBR网格导出上优于现有SOTA方法。

papers.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
papers.authors: Mei Yuan, Qi Long, Qifeng Wu, Zhenyang Li, Yizhou Zhao, Lei Wang, Yang Liu, Min Xu
papers.tags: object detection, tracking, Segment Anything, video search
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, University of Alabama at Birmingham, Griffith University
papers.intro: 本文提出O-VAD，一个无需训练、无领域知识的智能体框架，通过VLM驱动的物体发现、时空管状物跟踪和链式推理，基于物体状态演化进行工业视频异常检测，在三个IVAD数据集上达到SOTA性能，并输出开放式的异常类型、框架定位和因果分析报告。

papers.title: Occlusion-Aware Panoptic Segmentation with Joint Position Embedding and Occlusion-Level Attention
papers.authors: Wenbo Wei, Jun Wang, Shan Raza, Abhir Bhalerao
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, University of Warwick, Coventry, UK
papers.intro: 本文提出一个轻量级遮挡感知模块PEMOLA，通过联合利用遮挡级注意力和标签嵌入来调制位置编码，有效提升Transformer全景分割方法在遮挡场景下的性能。

papers.title: SpEmoC: A Balanced Speaker-Segment Multimodal Emotion Benchmark
papers.authors: Sania Bano, Shahzad Ahmad, Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, Sukalpa Chanda, Subrahmanyam Murala
papers.affiliations: 未明确（正文中每个作者有具体机构，见第十二部分）
papers.intro: 论文提出了SpEmoC，一个从3100部英语电影/电视剧中提取、经过严格平衡筛选的30k说话片段多模态情感基准数据集，通过混合标注管道、电影级划分策略和全面实验证明了平衡数据设计对模型泛化与鲁棒性的重要性。

papers.title: Anticipate Before Acting: Future-State-Conditioned Vision-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Lingfeng Zhang, Zhanguang Zhang, Liheng Ma, Tongtong Cao, Yingxue Zhang
papers.affiliations: Noah's Ark Lab, 2012 Labs, Huawei; Department of Foundation model, 2012 Labs, Huawei
papers.intro: 该论文提出未来状态条件化的VLN（FSC-VLN），通过在因果VLM中插入未来查询令牌，并在训练时将其隐状态与冻结视觉编码器提取的未来观测嵌入对齐，在不改变推理流程和增加额外开销的前提下提升导航决策质量。

papers.title: SAMRI-3D: Adapting SAM2 for 3D MRI Segmentation with Global Volume Tokens
papers.authors: Zhao Wang, Wei Dai, Hongfu Sun, Craig Engstrom, Shekhar S. Chandra
papers.affiliations: The University of Queensland, University of Newcastle
papers.intro: 本文提出SAMRI-3D，包含目前最大规模的MRI分割基准（34个数据集、10,392个体积）以及一种冻结SAM2图像编码器、仅微调解码器和记忆模块、并引入全局体积令牌（GVT）与截断符号距离场（TSDF）重建损失的方法，在34个数据集上达到平均Dice=0.78，且零样本泛化未见下降。

papers.title: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
papers.authors: Yin Wang, Haotian Hu, Jineng Han, Wentao Qiu, Zhenhua Ge, Liujian Tang, Fanyi Wang
papers.tags: visual question answering, OCR, visual grounding, edge deployment, gui
papers.affiliations: StepX Team（具体机构未明确）
papers.intro: StepX-Edge是一个0.9B参数的端侧UI视觉语言模型，通过架构-训练-部署的三层协同设计（UI感知视觉编码、渐进式维度投影、五阶段课程训练以及模块差异化量化），在≤1B参数规模下取得了最强的UI理解性能，并成功部署于骁龙8 Gen5平台。

papers.title: Sidekick: Designing Communication for Effective Multitasking with Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Ruei-Che Chang, Wenqian Xu, Dingzeyu Li, Bryan Wang, Anhong Guo
papers.affiliations: UMich（密歇根大学）; Adobe Research
papers.intro: Sidekick通过在不同交互阶段（后台、恢复、前台）提供环境线索、多模态摘要和推理可视化等多模态反馈，显著改善了用户与计算机使用代理在多任务场景下的协作效率和错误可追溯性。

papers.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Yuhan Zhu, Changlian Ma, Xiangyu Zeng, Xinhao Li, Zhiqiu Zhang, Songze Li, Jun Zhang, Tianxiang Jiang, Yuandong Yang, Ziang Yan, Zikang Wang, Xinyu Chen, Haoran Chen, Shaowei Zhang, Limin Wang
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University; Shanghai AI Laboratory; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Zhejiang University; University of Science and Technology of China; Fudan University
papers.intro: TimeLens2 通过将时间证据视为区间集合，在监督构建中采用分阶段证据验证流水线（TimeLens2-93K），在优化中提出基于精确一维 Wasserstein 距离的匹配自由奖励，实现了跨视频长度、领域、查询形式和视角的通用视频时间定位，并以 2B、4B、8B 紧凑模型在多个基准上超越了远超其…

papers.title: Teach it to stop, not just to click
papers.authors: Barada Sahu, Shivesh Pandey
papers.affiliations: Cabal AI; Para AI
papers.intro: 本文通过验证器引导的修复方法，系统性地评估了一个35B计算机使用智能体在五个环境中的修复可靠性，发现单次运行的评估结果被上游方差支配，并提出了k-seed报告协议和两档难度梯度结论。

papers.title: EvoGUI: An Evolution-Aware Benchmark for GUI State-Transition Understanding
papers.authors: Yaohan Yang, Minglei Shi, Borui Zhang, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.affiliations: Department of Automation, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 本文提出EvoGUI，一个将规范化GUI轨迹自动转化为三类视觉问答探针（时间排序、逆动作/值预测、单步后继判别）的无额外标注诊断框架，并构建了包含3000个实例、覆盖120个领域的EvoGUI-Bench基准，对28种视觉语言模型零样本评估后发现当前最佳模型仅达60.4 EvoGain，说明状态转换…

papers.title: When Do Multimodal and Graph-Augmented RAG Help? A Controlled Evaluation for Document Question Answering
papers.authors: Sokipriala Jonah
papers.affiliations: Centre for Computational Science and Mathematical Modelling, Coventry University, Coventry, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文通过固定检索栈、独立消融文本/图/视觉证据的晚期融合RAG架构，在1000页PubLayNet语料上评估四种生成器，发现知识图谱增强无可靠收益，多模态增强仅在纯像素问题上带来小幅提升，且严重受图像检索召回率和生成器图像理解能力制约。

papers.title: Knowing the Self, Understanding the World: A Dual-Cognition Benchmark for UAV Spatio-temporal Reasoning with MLLMs
papers.authors: Like Liu, Zhengzheng Xu, Haitao He, Hongzhe Li, Shuchang Zhang, Dian Shao
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University (Like Liu, Zhengzheng Xu, Haitao He, Shuchang Zhang, Dian Shao); China University of Petroleum (Hongzhe Li)
papers.intro: 本文提出UAV-DualCog基准，通过构建多视角时空推理的图像和视频任务，系统评估MLLM在无人机场景中的自感知与环境感知的双认知能力，并验证其作为监督数据源的价值。
